notes:
Summary: Large IoT telemetry provider; running edge collectors + central analytics. Interested in Private (VPC) deployment to keep tokenization + inference off public internet. Primary ask: strong network controls, KMS integration, and audit trail to SIEM.

Key quotes: "We cannot have model payloads routed over public egress — must be inside our VPC or via PrivateLink." — VP Eng.

Network security specifics discussed: PrivateLink endpoints vs VPC Peering (prefers PrivateLink for cross-account isolation), explicit firewall rules on subnets, egress proxies with allowlist only, mandatory NAT gateway logging, and mandatory IDS/IPS inspection on egress. Wants IP allowlists for management plane and control plane, and support for single-IP public endpoints for on-prem bridges.

KMS / crypto: Requires KMS integration with customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) and HSM-backed key material. Key rotation policy must be supported; Redwood must expose key wrap/unwrapped options per security team. Need disclosure of where key material is stored (customer-managed KMS vs Redwood-managed) and proof of zero-access handling.

Audit & logging: Real-time audit logs shipped to Splunk/Datadog/Sumo (customer preference: Splunk). Need request-level logs (who/what/model/route), token-level cost attribution mapping to internal cost centers, and 2-year retention for audit logs. Logs must be delivered via a VPC endpoint into their logging VPC.

Data residency & policy: Production inference must remain in us-east-1 for regulatory reasons (contracts with carriers). No replication to other regions without explicit opt-in. Also asked about data retention on cache/KV — must be configurable to 0s for PII workloads.

POC scope agreed: 3-week technical POC. Week 1: network connectivity (PrivateLink + peering options), credentialing, KMS test. Week 2: deploy sample model, run 10k/min stream test with batching. Week 3: audit log delivery and failover exercises.

Commercial notes: evaluating Dedicated reserved nodes vs Private deployment. Cost sensitivity moderate — prefer predictable reserved pricing for production; will accept higher cost for Private with HSM/KMS guarantees.

Relationships: AE = Alex Rivera (owning); SE = Priya Shah (security deep dives).

Stated blockers: Legal needs KMS/HSM SOC/PDFs; Security team needs detailed network diagrams and AWS Principal ARNs for PrivateLink; Procurement requires SOW + SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence before committing.
